name: Standing Machine Calf Raise
equipment: Plate-loaded standing calf-raise machine with padded shoulder yoke, stable handle grips and raised forefoot block
grip: Hands gently hold machine handles; balls of both feet on block, heels free; feet hip-width, knees softly extended
start: Standing upright beneath padded shoulder yoke. Heels lowered slightly below forefoot block in a comfortable calf stretch, knees nearly straight and trunk stacked.
movement: Same yoke and machine; both heels raised high above forefoot block, ankles plantarflexed, body and shoulder yoke elevated visibly while knees remain nearly straight.
muscles: Gastrocnemius and soleus orange; tibialis posterior muted blue; trunk stabilizers grey-green
avoid: No squat, bent-knee seated pose, heels on the block, floating machine pads or deep forced ankle range.

name: Deficit Barbell RDL
equipment: Standard barbell with two balanced weight plates, one stable low 5-cm-wide platform beneath both feet
grip: Double overhand shoulder-width grip, feet hip-width fully supported on the same broad low platform, knees softly bent
camera: Side three-quarter view showing bar path and platform
start: Tall stance on low platform, bar hanging against upper thighs, shoulders over hips and spine neutral.
movement: Hip hinge with hips back and neutral spine; torso angled forward about 45–60 degrees. Bar travels close to shins and slightly below ordinary shin height, knees retain small bend; stop before any lumbar rounding.
muscles: Hamstrings and gluteus maximus orange; spinal erectors muted blue; trunk and grip stabilizers grey-green
avoid: No conventional floor deadlift, deep squat, locked knees, rounded back, excessive depth or feet on separate unstable plates.

name: Stick Overhead Deep Squats
equipment: One straight lightweight off-white mobility stick about 1.5 metres long, no weights
grip: Wide overhand grip near stick ends, elbows straight overhead; feet shoulder-width, toes gently turned out
camera: Front three-quarter view with full stick and feet
start: Upright stance, stick overhead above mid-foot, ribs stacked over pelvis and feet flat.
movement: Controlled comfortable deep squat, hips below knee level only while heels stay grounded and spine remains neutral; stick stays overhead above mid-foot, knees follow toes.
muscles: Quadriceps and glutes subtle orange; upper back and shoulders muted blue; trunk grey-green
avoid: No stick resting across shoulders, heels lifted, knees collapsing inward, forced shoulder range, weighted bar or unsupported extreme arch.

name: Sissy Squat
equipment: Bodyweight on stable floor; no machine or external weight
grip: Arms extended forward for counterbalance, feet hip-width, toes facing forward
camera: Clear side view of knee flexion and heels
start: Standing tall with softly unlocked knees and arms held forward at shoulder level.
movement: Controlled bodyweight sissy squat: knees travel forward, heels rise, thighs and torso form a nearly straight backward-leaning line; moderate knee bend, hips not folded into a normal squat, no extreme depth.
muscles: Quadriceps orange; gluteal and calf muscles muted blue; trunk grey-green
avoid: No kneeling pose, normal hip-hinge squat, exaggerated lumbar arch, deep painful knee angle or invented resistance.

name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
equipment: Plate-loaded seated calf-raise machine, padded thigh lever just above knees and raised forefoot block
grip: Hands hold machine handles; seated upright, knees near 90 degrees, balls of both feet on block and heels free
start: Seated with thigh pads contacting thighs, heels lowered comfortably beneath block, both feet stable.
movement: Same machine and thigh-pad placement, heels lift high and ankle extension elevates lever and weight; knees remain bent near 90 degrees, torso upright.
muscles: Soleus orange; gastrocnemius muted blue; trunk stabilizers grey-green
avoid: No standing calf raise, thigh pads on kneecaps, whole feet on block, bouncing or changed machine geometry.

name: Incline Smith Machine Press 45°
equipment: Smith machine with two parallel vertical rails and attached balanced barbell; adjustable bench backrest exactly 45 degrees from floor
grip: Overhand grip just outside shoulder-width, feet planted, shoulders retracted against bench, forearms vertical
camera: Side three-quarter view with both complete rails and bench angle visible
start: Reclined on 45-degree bench, bar just above upper chest, elbows below wrists and about 45–60 degrees from torso, wrists straight.
movement: Bar pressed upward along the same Smith rails until arms are almost straight above upper chest; scapulae remain supported, feet and bench unchanged.
muscles: Upper pectoralis major orange; anterior deltoids and triceps muted blue; rotator cuff grey-green
avoid: No near-upright shoulder press, free barbell, missing rail attachments, bar behind neck, floating feet or equipment cut off.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
equipment: One low cable pulley station with single D-handle and taut cable from behind the athlete
grip: One supinated grip; split stance facing away from pulley, working upper arm slightly behind torso, other hand relaxed
camera: Side three-quarter showing low pulley behind and entire cable path
start: Working arm extended down and slightly behind hip; palm forward/up, elbow softly unlocked, shoulder stable, cable taut behind hand.
movement: Elbow bends to curl D-handle toward shoulder while upper arm remains slightly behind torso and trunk stays upright; cable still reaches low pulley behind.
muscles: Biceps brachii orange; brachialis and brachioradialis muted blue; shoulder/trunk stabilizers grey-green
avoid: No high pulley, preacher support, both arms working, elbow drifting far forward, torso swing or cable passing through body.

name: Overhead Dual-Cable Tricep Extension
equipment: Dual adjustable cable columns behind the athlete, two independent handles and two taut cables routed outside the shoulders
grip: One handle in each hand, neutral grip, split stance facing away from columns; upper arms overhead, elbows near shoulder-width
camera: Side-front three-quarter view showing both cable columns and cable connections
start: Both elbows bent approximately 90–110 degrees, hands behind crown of head, upper arms overhead, ribs stacked, cables taut from behind.
movement: Extend both elbows to bring hands upward-forward above head, keeping upper arms stable and elbows softly unlocked; same cable columns and split stance.
muscles: Triceps especially long head orange; deltoids muted blue; trunk/rotator cuff grey-green
avoid: No single rope cable, pressdown, handles fused together, cables crossing neck, flared elbows or exaggerated lumbar arch.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
equipment: Standing plate-loaded chest-supported T-bar row machine with inclined chest pad, foot platform, pivoting lever, near-end weight plates and parallel neutral handles
grip: Neutral parallel handles, feet on machine platform, chest continuously supported on inclined pad, knees softly bent
camera: Side three-quarter full lever and chest-pad view
start: Chest against inclined support, arms extended down-forward toward handles, spine neutral, lever lowered but not resting on floor.
movement: Pull identical handles toward lower ribs, elbows travel back beside torso; chest stays on same pad and athlete remains standing on platform. Lever and plates rise through hinge path.
muscles: Latissimus and middle trapezius orange; rhomboids, rear deltoids and biceps muted blue; trunk grey-green
avoid: No seated machine row, free bent-over T-bar row, chest lifting from pad, different lever or seated posture between phases.

name: Incline DB Press
equipment: Two balanced dumbbells and adjustable bench with backrest at the authored 30-degree incline
grip: Palms forward, grip slightly outside shoulder-width, feet planted, shoulders supported/retracted
camera: Side three-quarter with low 30-degree bench angle unmistakable
start: Reclined on 30-degree bench, dumbbells beside upper chest, elbows bent near 90 degrees and 45–60 degrees from torso; forearms vertical.
movement: Press both dumbbells upward and slightly inward above upper chest, elbows almost straight; preserve low incline, back/feet contact and equipment positions.
muscles: Upper pectoralis major orange; anterior deltoids and triceps muted blue; rotator cuff grey-green
avoid: No upright bench, 45-degree inherited Smith setup, seated shoulder press, floating feet, dumbbells touching or shoulder hyperextension.
sourceEvidence: CANONICAL-MOVEMENTS.json periodized-incline-db-press explicitly says bench 30 degrees; do not inherit primary Smith 45 degrees.

name: Wide-Stance Leg Press
equipment: One 45-degree plate-loaded sled leg-press machine with reclined seat/backrest, broad footplate, two side rails, balanced plates and side handles
grip: Hands hold side handles, back and pelvis remain on pads; feet wide on same footplate, toes gently turned out, heels fully planted
camera: Side-front three-quarter view showing foot placement, backrest and whole sled frame
start: Knees bent near 90 degrees with footplate close enough to show stable loaded setup; lower back stays against pad, knees follow toes.
movement: Press identical sled up same rails to nearly extended knees without locking; wide foot placement, planted heels and backrest support unchanged, sled visibly farther from seat.
muscles: Quadriceps, gluteus maximus and adductors orange; hamstrings muted blue; trunk grey-green
avoid: No horizontal seated stack machine, single-leg stance, feet lifting, knees collapsing inward, extreme depth, locked knees or different machine between phases.

name: Dumbbell Pullover on Flat Bench
equipment: One balanced dumbbell held in both hands and one horizontal flat bench supporting upper back crosswise, feet planted on floor
grip: Both palms support inside of upper dumbbell head; elbows softly bent at constant angle; feet shoulder-width and knees bent, upper back supported across bench
camera: Side three-quarter view showing cross-bench torso support, both feet, whole dumbbell and bench
start: Upper back lies across flat bench, head supported near pad edge, hips level with torso without excessive arch; dumbbell above chest and elbows softly bent.
movement: Arc same dumbbell behind head through comfortable shoulder flexion, elbows retain slight bend; ribcage controlled, hips and feet stable, upper back on same crosswise support. Stop near upper arms beside ears, never force below comfortable shoulder range.
muscles: Latissimus and pectoralis major restrained orange; serratus anterior and long-head triceps muted blue; trunk stabilizers grey-green
avoid: No longitudinal full-body bench support, cable, bent-elbow skullcrusher, forced deep shoulder stretch, dropped hips, exaggerated lumbar arch or different apparatus between phases.
sourceEvidence: data/periodized-abc.js authored optionalDetails: Lie across the bench with one dumbbell over the chest and elbows softly bent; arc behind the head while ribs stay down. Existing Monday V3 pair is lengthwise supported, not this authored cross-bench setup.

name: 45° Incline Leg Press (Mid-Stance)
equipment: One 45-degree plate-loaded sled leg-press machine with full parallel rails, broad footplate, reclined padded seat/backrest, balanced plates and side safety handles
grip: Hands on side handles; back and pelvis supported, both feet shoulder-width at middle of footplate, toes gently outward and heels planted
camera: Front-side three-quarter showing complete machine, footplate, both feet and knee path
start: Supported reclined seated setup, feet shoulder-width at mid-platform; sled held with knees softly extended, not locked, shoulders and pelvis on pads.
movement: Lower the identical sled along the same 45-degree rails with both knees bent near 90 degrees, following toe direction; keep heels planted, pelvis/back on pads and hands on same side handles.
muscles: Quadriceps restrained orange; gluteus maximus muted blue; trunk stabilizers grey-green
avoid: No wide sumo stance, horizontal weight-stack machine, hack squat, walking lunge, single-leg stance, raised heels, pelvis rolling off pad, locked knees, extreme depth or cropped plates/footplate/rails.
sourceEvidence: CANONICAL-MOVEMENTS.json biweekly-45-incline-leg-press-mid-stance explicitly specifies 45-degree leg press, shoulder-width feet and 90-degree controlled descent; source rows 29/94; alias 45° Incline Leg Press. NASM leg-press reference supports supported back, side handles, controlled knee flexion and avoiding lockout. Do not map generic Leg Press renamed from Hack Squat because its tier instructions conflict. Existing V3 exact pair has cropped upper equipment so a distinct replacement is needed.
